# Starlink Mini Accessories — Shop

Page: https://starlink.biscuitthecampingbulldog.com/

A shop for Starlink Mini internet gear for RV, overland and off-grid travel: mounts, batteries and power supplies, attachment hardware and travel cases — all made by Veritas Vans. Every order button links to the matching product on veritasvans.com through the shop's partner link.

Who runs it: Starlink Mini Accessories, the Starlink gear shop run by the team behind Biscuit the Camping Bulldog (Denise & Jeffrey Myers, full-time RVers). Affiliate partner of Veritas Vans; orders may earn the shop a commission at no extra cost to the buyer.

Good to know: Free US shipping on Veritas Vans orders.
